text: Thank you for sharing those details. To better understand your condition, have you noticed any blood in your urine, and when did these symptoms first begin?

speaker: Patient
text: 17-year-old female. The patient presents with a 5-day history of severe abdominal pain and cramping, accompanied by nausea and vomiting. She reports pain with urination and also experienced burning pain during sexual intercourse 3 days ago. She mentions being sexually active with one male partner, using condoms inconsistently.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Genitourinary Syndrome (likely Urethritis/Pyelonephritis secondary to Chlamydia Trachomatis or Neisseria Gonorrhoeae). Given the dysuria, dyspareunia, and recent sexual history, this is highly suggestive of an STI causing ascending infection.

REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis, Urine Culture, NAAT for Chlamydia and Gonorrhea.
REQUEST IMAGES: Renal_Ultrasound.
